about_the_game:
Start your journey as a young panda pilot whose loving mother spent the family savings to buy you your very first delivery drone — and even registered your business under P.A.N.D.A. (Prompt Agile New Delivery Alliance). Now it’s your turn to take to the skies and make her proud!

Fly across a colorful, open world filled with animal characters and hidden surprises. Deliver parcels big and small while exploring.

Some deliveries are urgent and must arrive on time, while others let you slow down, relax, and enjoy the peaceful rhythm of flight. Always keep an eye on your battery levels.

Whether you’re uncovering secrets, delivering parcels, or simply admiring the view from above, every flight brings you closer to becoming the best delivery panda pilot in the world.

Features

  • 🌍 Explore a vibrant open world.

  • 📦 Deliver parcels to animal inhabitants.

  • ⏱️ Both urgent timed deliveries or laid-back routes.

  • ⛽ Manage fuel to plan your flights.

  • 🐼 Play as a lovable panda pilot with a big heart.

Take flight, deliver hope, and bring the world closer together — one parcel at a time.

The game features simplified, easy-to-learn controls designed for casual players.

While it doesn’t use realistic drone flight physics, you can customize button and joystick mappings in the options menu to suit your play style.
